name: PipesAndFilters
summary: Divides a larger processing task into a sequence of independent steps joined by channels, so that a step can be reordered, reused or replaced without the others knowing.

roles.name: Filter
roles.summary: One processing step. It reads from a channel and writes to a channel, and knows nothing of what precedes or follows it — which is the whole property that lets the sequence be rearranged.

roles.name: Pipe
roles.summary: The channel joining two steps. Making it a participant rather than a call is what decouples the steps in time and lets one be replaced while the other runs.

roles.name: Pipeline
roles.summary: The assembled sequence. It is the only participant that knows the order, so the order is stated in one place rather than implied by who calls whom.
